text:
Situation: Corvale East has 2 days of supply for gentamicin sulfate 40 mg/mL 2 mL vials (NDC 00409120703). Corvale General holds 15 days of the same strength and can spare 16 vials while retaining two weeks of inventory. Corvale Lakeside holds 7.7 days. The product is labeled by Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) as the registered plant for manufacture, analysis, labeling, and packing.

Why (FDA record): FDA’s drug shortage database shows gentamicin sulfate has not been listed since 2021-07-23. The Hospira plant received a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12 and OAI inspections on 2011-06-17 and 2011-08-04. A 2019-11-21 inspection was classified VAI, 610 days before this posting.

Our position: No national shortage is posted. The immediate gap is local to Corvale East. Internal transfer is the fastest, lowest-risk step. Alternate manufacturers are not on FDA’s shortage list and have acceptable recent inspection histories where known.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy director approves transfer of 16 vials of gentamicin sulfate 40 mg/mL 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East.
2. Buyer places orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC to replenish Corvale General stock.
3. Buyer evaluates Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Eugia US LLC, and HF Acquisition Co LLC (DBA HealthFirst) as secondary sources and places orders if pricing and lead times are acceptable.

Not recommended: Delaying the transfer while awaiting new purchase orders; Corvale East would remain below safety stock.
